correctness.rationale: For all D,L,r>0 and probability reset sources on the open ring cut, the Neumann Green kernel solves the forced stationary equation and has known positive boundary values U,V. The explicit homogeneous flux response h fixes p(0),p(L),J and normalization exactly. The interface dissipation reduces to a strictly concave universal one-variable function, proving existence, uniqueness and positivity under U≠V and the exact degeneracy under U=V. Implicit differentiation and atanh inequalities establish monotone optimizer, sharp constants and the small-t expansion. Hyperbolic identities prove point-source location and two rate limits, and joint convexity proves the distribution-independent bound. A direct boundary-value checker passed 110 point/70 mixture cases with 10 optimizer tests; these finite checks support but do not substitute the analytic proof. No unproved necessity, hidden uniqueness, or strong-field numerical extrapolation is used.

originality.rationale: The originating 2024 paper gives the exact stochastic-thermodynamic interfacial contribution and the stationary Brownian ring solution and demonstrates nonmonotonicity numerically. These are prior. The assessed non-covered conclusions are a quantified all-reset-laws uniqueness theorem (with the zero-contrast exception), a scalar universal optimizer with two sharp dimensionless bounds and strict contrast monotonicity, weak/strong-rate laws for point resetting, and a distribution-independent endpoint-source supremum. These require an additional strictly concave universal reduction and quantified endpoint/source comparisons not provided in the inspected primary result. The source formulas make this deduction possible and remain a substantive originality risk; no claim of independence from those formulas is made.
residual_risks: The original 2024 source contains an exact full stationary solution for the self-review, so the new optimization theorem may be regarded as a nontrivial consequence of that closed form; originality is specific to the rigorously quantified global classification and sharp bounds, not to the entropy function itself.
Unindexed or uninspected papers may have derived the same scalar optimization from the original stationary formulas.
A related 2024 crossing-statistics paper was inspected by relevant sections but not exhaustively checked through every appendix; a hidden equivalent model reduction cannot be absolutely excluded.
Some published treatments use a different factor convention for interface permeability, requiring conversion before numerical comparisons.

value.rationale: The motivating study demonstrates but does not classify the nonmonotone membrane-entropy response. The new exact all-reset-law uniqueness criterion, strict dimensionless interval of achievable dissipation-maximizing permeabilities, identifiable source-contrast control, singular large-reset-rate coefficient and source-placement envelope are motivated physically by tuning membrane coupling for a fixed nonequilibrium resetting protocol. They replace representative plots and parameter sweeps by reproducible sharp engineering/mathematical limits. This is more informative than a textbook normalization exercise or an arbitrary numerical slice; the result explicitly distinguishes the boundary-balanced degenerate case and optimizes only the membrane contribution, not total entropy.
